title: Full Hunter's Moon Goat Yoga
long_description:
Join us for a fall evening of Goats and Yoga under the Hunter's Moon.

About this Event

Full Hunter's Moon Goat Yoga
Monday October 26, 2026 from 6:00 to 7:00.
What better way to end your day? Join us at Chip-In Farm for a Full Harvest Moon Goat Yoga class featuring our herd of friendly baby goats! Goat kids are naturally curious and playful, and our little goats love to cuddle.
While this may not be the most meditative and relaxing yoga class you've ever been to, it will surely be the most memorable - perfect for melting that stress away!
The class is suitable for all levels of yoga experience and taught by a Ceritfied Yoga Instructor.
Bring your own mat, blanket, or towel but be prepared for the goats to potentially taste test everything!
We recommend towels for easy cleaning. The yoga class will take place outside in the evening so bring layers in case of colder weather.
$30.00 class fee per person includes 1 hour of yoga instruction with time to pet, hold, and take pictures with the goats.

Refund: Refunds issued with 24 hour notice. In the event a refund is needed, Eventbrite's processing fees will be passed to the customer.

Also check out other Health & Wellness events in Bedford, Workshops in Bedford.
